items.title: KUZZ-TV/UPN commercials, 10/16/1996
items.description: Aired during Star Trek: Voyager. Co-owned by Buck Owens at that time (who also owned KUZZ AM 55/FM 107.9, still a country station), it later became KUVI, went to MyNetworkTV in 2006 and is now a pass-through signal for True Crime Network. How times have changed in Bakersfield...
